name: vagaa-web-evidence
description: Free-first public-web search and page extraction through your own evidence router: one call per turn, citations only from extracted bodies, no paid provider without asking.

nole_mcp_url.title: Web-evidence MCP URL
nole_mcp_url.description: Streamable-HTTP MCP endpoint of your evidence router. Compact surface (one tool): https://search.example.com/mcp-compact — standard surface (six tools): https://search.example.com/mcp. Must agree with the profile below.

nole_credential.title: Web-evidence credential
nole_credential.description: 直连填服务令牌,公网填网关密钥,不可互换. With profile=lan this is the router's own service token; with profile=public it is the gateway's external API key. The two are different secrets: sending one to the other address does not authenticate. Stored in your OS keychain.

profile.title: Connection profile
profile.description: Which address the URL above is: lan (direct to the router, its own service token) or public (through the gateway, the gateway's API key). Picks the wording of the session-start check and nothing else. Allowed values: lan, public.
